## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed claim carries a dated, trustworthy source (official docs first).
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or `.env` values added anywhere.
- [ ] Wikilinks resolve (no dead `[[links]]`); new notes have full frontmatter.
- [ ] No em dashes in note bodies (use `-` or `:`).
- [ ] If code changed: `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] If a fast-moving fact changed (pricing, endpoints, limits): `references/current-requirements.md` updated with a retrieval date.
